# Repository Community Standards

The public repository is intended for transparent development and collaboration while preserving project ownership and third-party rights.

Authoritative policies:

- `LICENSE` — project ownership and reuse terms.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — contribution workflow and engineering invariants.
- `CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md` — collaboration expectations.
- `SECURITY.md` — vulnerability reporting and security boundaries.
- `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` — structured issue intake for bugs, features, Product Reality findings, and documentation problems.

The existing pull-request template remains the standard review entry point for proposed code changes.
